# SentinelFlow & SentinelPulse — Full Technical Knowledge Base
> SentinelFlow is an enterprise autonomous AI dispute investigation copilot built on LangGraph that orchestrates multi-agent evidence collection, deterministic risk evaluation, and human-in-the-loop steering. SentinelPulse is a high-throughput, synchronous telecom trust-and-safety gateway delivering sub-15ms SMS and voice fraud classification using quantized ONNX Runtime CPU models and Redis sliding-window velocity aggregators.

---

## 1. System Overview & Core Capabilities

SentinelFlow coordinates an autonomous multi-agent dispute investigation lifecycle. SentinelPulse enforces real-time telecom trust-and-safety with strict sub-15ms ingress SLAs.

### Core Architecture Pillars:
- **LangGraph Multi-Agent Engine**: Intake -> Investigate -> Collect (Parallel async tool execution via asyncio.gather) -> Synthesize -> Approval (Human-in-the-Loop interrupt) -> Finalize.
- **Cryptographic Audit Ledger**: Every investigation step is recorded in an append-only ledger linked by SHA-256 row hashes (sequence_no, prev_hash, row_hash), providing verifiable non-repudiation.
- **SentinelPulse Real-Time Gateway**: Sub-15ms synchronous SMS inspection using ONNX Runtime CPU (TF-IDF + calibrated classifier) and Redis sliding-window velocity aggregation (10s, 60s, 1h).
- **Explainable AI Workbench**: Next.js 16 console with client-side Time-Travel State Scrubbing (<0.03ms per step), semantic iteration diffs (?diff=1), and sticky cross-panel evidence citation pinning (?evidence=EVD-xxx).

---

## 2. System Capability Comparison Matrix

| Capability / Dimension | Legacy Rules Engine (2020) | SentinelFlow Dispute Copilot | SentinelPulse Telecom Gateway |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Architecture** | Static If-Else & Hardcoded Rules | LangGraph Multi-Agent State Machine | Quantized ONNX Runtime CPU Pipeline |
| **Latency SLA** | 50ms – 500ms (Database bound) | Asynchronous Multi-Step (Background Workers) | **<15ms Synchronous** (p99 < 8ms) |
| **Decision Grounding** | Static Thresholds & Heuristics | Parallel Async Evidence Retrieval (`asyncio.gather`) | Multi-Window Velocity Aggregation (10s, 60s, 1h) |
| **Human-in-the-Loop** | Offline Ticketing Queue | Native LangGraph `interrupt()` at Risk >= 0.70 | Real-Time Inline `FLAG` Verdict & Feedback Loop |
| **Iterative Steering** | No Live Loop (Ticket Reassigned) | Re-investigation with Human Reviewer Guidance | Dynamic Velocity Threshold & Calibration Tuning |
| **Audit Ledger** | Mutable Application Database Logs | **Append-Only SHA-256 Hash Chain** Ledger | Append-Only Structured Telemetry Feed |
| **External Agent Access** | Internal REST APIs | **Remote MCP over SSE** (`/api/v1/mcp/sse`) | High-Throughput REST Ingress (`POST /v1/classify`) |
| **Explainability UI** | Static Notes & Form Submissions | Time-Travel Scrubber, Diff View, GenUI Cards | Live Telemetry Stream, KS/PSI Drift Gauges |

## 3. AI-First Protocols & Ingestion Matrix

| Layer | Protocol / Format | Target Agent / Consumer | Primary Function |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Discovery Manifest** | `/.well-known/mcp.json` | Remote MCP Clients (Cursor, Claude, Antigravity) | Machine-readable tool declarations |
| **Curated Digest** | `/llms.txt` | Context-constrained AI crawlers & LLM lookups | Curated markdown table of contents |
| **Full Technical Reference** | `/llms-full.txt` | Single-turn context-loading reasoning models | Complete architectural & API specification |
| **Content Negotiation** | `Accept: text/markdown` | Autonomous agents scraping HTTP endpoints | Clean markdown response without HTML chrome |
| **Crawler Governance** | `robots.txt` | Search vs. Training crawlers (`OAI-SearchBot`, `GPTBot`) | Decoupled citation vs. training access |
| **Structured Entities** | Schema.org JSON-LD | Search engines & AI answer engines (GEO) | Stacked entity graph (`SoftwareApplication`, `FAQ`, `HowTo`) |
| **Tool Execution** | Remote MCP over SSE (`/api/v1/mcp/sse`) | External Autonomous AI Agents | Live tool calling with SSE transport |

---

## 4. Remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) Endpoints
SentinelFlow exposes public tools for autonomous AI agents over standard MCP (2024-11-05 spec):
- **Discovery**: GET `/.well-known/mcp.json`
- **SSE Stream**: GET `/api/v1/mcp/sse`
- **Messages**: POST `/api/v1/mcp/messages`

### Available Tools:
1. `list_disputes(status?: str, limit?: int)`: Query and filter disputes with risk levels and customer details.
2. `get_investigation(dispute_id: str)`: Retrieve full multi-agent investigation timeline, hypotheses, and evidence.
3. `submit_review(dispute_id: str, investigation_id: str, decision: str, guidance?: str)`: Submit human reviewer decision (approve, reject, or request_revision with steering instructions).
4. `classify_telecom(sender_phone: str, message_body: str, client_ip?: str)`: Run real-time ONNX fraud classification (<15ms).

---

## 5. Dispute Investigation Lifecycle
```
[Dispute Ingested]
       │
       ▼
[intake] ──> Initializes DisputeState, loads customer & transaction data
       │
       ▼
[investigate] ──> LLM formulates competing hypotheses & requests tools
       │
       ├─ (Needs Tools / Analyzers) ──> [collect] (Parallel asyncio.gather) ──> [investigate]
       │
       ▼
[synthesize] ──> Evaluates deterministic compliance & normalized risk
       │
       ├─ (Risk < 0.70) ──> [finalize] ──> [Resolved]
       │
       ▼ (Risk >= 0.70)
[approval] ──> LangGraph native interrupt() halts for human review
       │
       ├─ Human: Approve / Reject ──> [finalize]
       │
       ▼ Human: Request Revision (guidance)
[investigate] ──> Resumes autonomous loop with steering context (Max 3 cycles)
```

---

## 6. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Machine-Readable Schema

SentinelFlow implements stacked Schema.org structured data uniting entity anchors:
- `SoftwareApplication`: Identifies SentinelFlow & SentinelPulse capabilities, feature sets, and execution environments.
- `Organization`: Identifies the SentinelFlow Open Source Initiative publisher entity.
- `FAQPage`: Provides authoritative answers to core architectural and governance queries using the Definition Lead pattern.
- `HowTo`: Documents the deterministic dispute investigation methodology.
- `Discovery Metadata`: Exposes `/api/v1/geo/metadata` for real-time observability of entity anchors, citation matrices, and documentation manifests.

---

## 7. REST API Quick Reference

### Ingestion & Discovery
- `GET /llms.txt`: Curated markdown table of contents for language models.
- `GET /llms-full.txt`: Full concatenated technical specification for 1-turn context loading.
- `GET /robots.txt`: Decoupled crawler governance policy.
- `GET /sitemap.xml`: Canonical sitemap indexing all public resources.
- `GET /api/v1/geo/metadata`: Generative Engine Optimization entity graph and citation metadata.

### Disputes & Investigations
- `GET /api/v1/disputes`: List disputes (Supports Accept: text/markdown content negotiation).
- `GET /api/v1/disputes/{id}`: Detailed dispute view with transaction history.
- `POST /api/v1/disputes/{id}/investigations`: Enqueue multi-agent investigation (arq + Redis).
- `GET /api/v1/disputes/{id}/investigations/latest`: Hydrate latest investigation run snapshot.
- `GET /api/v1/investigations/{id}/stream`: Real-time Server-Sent Events stream.

### Human-in-the-Loop Reviews
- `POST /api/v1/disputes/{id}/investigations/{inv_id}/review`:
  - Body: `{"decision": "approve" | "reject" | "request_revision", "guidance": "string"}`

### SentinelPulse Real-Time Gateway
- `POST /v1/classify`: Real-time SMS inspection:
  - Request: `{"sender_phone": "+12025550199", "message_body": "Your code is 123456", "client_ip": "1.2.3.4"}`
  - Response: `{"verdict": "ALLOW" | "FLAG" | "BLOCK", "risk_score": 0.05, "latency_ms": 1.2}`
- `POST /v1/events/batch`: High-throughput batch classification.
- `GET /metrics`: Prometheus metrics.
